cards.name: Elkin Lair
cards.oracleText: At the beginning of each player's upkeep, that player exiles a card at random from their hand. The player may play that card this turn. At the beginning of the next end step, if the player hasn't played the card, they put it into their graveyard.

cards.name: Elkin Bottle
cards.oracleText: {3}, {T}: Exile the top card of your library. Until the beginning of your next upkeep, you may play that card.
